data.name: Edsel
data.long_meaning: The name Edsel is derived from Old English words ed, meaning 'wealth,' and sel, meaning 'pledge' or 'prosperous.' It was a popular name in England during the Middle Ages and was brought to America by early settlers. The name carries a strong sense of wealth, prosperity, and security.

in_greek.name: Εντσέλ
